role: Point-to-set calibration criterion CORRECTED + P3 re-open on the qualified point-to-set observable. Records the v22 QUALIFIED ruling (by owner criterion-withdrawal — POST-RESULT, dated, flagged; full reasoning in docs/findings/Pebble-P2b-pointset.md) and seals the honest criterion form + the dichotomy expectation for any FUTURE point-to-set run.
extends: v21 (point-to-set instrument), v22 (redesign #1). The v22 run stands; this corrects the criterion and re-opens P3.

v22_verdict_ruling.verdict: QUALIFIED (redesign #1). The point-to-set instrument recovers the reach dichotomy corr inverted: affine/parity HIGH (0.35-0.38) vs bounded-width LOW (0.18-0.21), non-overlapping; parity moved from the corr floor (0.03) to the top group.
v22_verdict_ruling.criterion_withdrawal_provenance: the v22 strict-single-max clause ('parity THE top') is WITHDRAWN as an owner SPECIFICATION ERROR — POST-RESULT (after run de64f4f, 2026-07-22 19:56), dated and flagged so a reader can judge it. Reason: 2-affine is also affine/globally-rigid/point-to-set-long — the same class as parity — and was sealed as the co-long CONSISTENCY REFERENCE before measurement (prereg_v22, cc8bc14). The literal criterion demanded parity outrank its own class-mate, which no physical mechanism produces; the 0.02 gap sits inside overlapping intervals. The bar was written to test the corr INVERSION (which it does); the strict within-class rank is an artifact it should not have carried. NOT a 'nearly met, call it met' — a corrected specification.
v22_verdict_ruling.not_a_precedent_for_loosening: this withdrawal is a documented owner spec-error correction with dated pre-result evidence, not a license to relax sealed thresholds after seeing data. RESIZED/refuted verdicts elsewhere stand.

corrected_criterion_sealed_for_future_ru.form: affine-class HIGH vs bounded-width LOW, NON-OVERLAPPING bootstrap intervals between the groups; SAME-CLASS CO-TOP PERMITTED (a co-long class-mate — e.g. 2-affine — reading at or above parity does NOT fail the instrument).
corrected_criterion_sealed_for_future_ru.reach_score: point-to-set signal at the fixed radius r=2 (prereg_v22, pinned; largest-valid-radius retired as finite-size-collapsed). Sensitivity metrics (persistence ratio, AUC) reported, never substituted.
corrected_criterion_sealed_for_future_ru.poles: affine/parity (3-XOR, 2-affine) as the HIGH class; bounded-width (2-SAT at >=2 connected densities) as the LOW class. All poles CONNECTED (the low-density small-component confound is retired).

dichotomy_expectation_sealed_before_P3.claim: point-to-set reach on Boolean CSP families may be DICHOTOMOUS — affine-class long, bounded-width short, with NO meaningful middle level — tracking the Schaefer/algebraic dichotomy. The four calibration poles landed in exactly two groups with a clean gap and nothing between.
dichotomy_expectation_sealed_before_P3.P3_tests_it: P3 (re-opened on the point-to-set observable) measures the census families and tests whether the two-level structure holds across the roster, or whether an intermediate level appears.
dichotomy_expectation_sealed_before_P3.phase_2_consequence: IF the dichotomy holds, the sealed differential prediction (prereg_v12/v13, framed as a strong/moderate/weak/none GRADIENT) should expect TWO LEVELS rather than a gradient on the point-to-set observable. The sealed table is NOT rewritten; the dichotomy is the expectation to TEST, sealed here before P3 re-opens.

P3_reopens.observable: measure_pointset (foundry/foundry/pointset.py), reach_score = signal at r=2, the QUALIFIED point-to-set instrument. The disqualified corr instrument (reach.py) is NOT used for reach; it stays on the record at its rescoped pairwise size.
P3_reopens.carried: exact/sampled provenance + POP_CAP/TARGET_CAP caps (v19/v21); the bucket-population floor (MIN_SOLUTIONS=16, MIN_BUCKETS=4) as a pre-fit gate; the R-2 arity diagnostic; scaling across sizes; the two-level (dichotomy) expectation as the sealed prediction.
